column1: # Per-rule false-positive ceilings. One row per rule that has one; a rule with
# no row here is held to zero on both columns. Fields, tab separated:
#   rule_id       the rule the ceiling belongs to
#   max_corpus    findings this rule may leave on NONE rows of manifest.tsv
#   max_per_kloc  findings per thousand code lines this rule may leave on any
#                 one repository of the pinned noise set. The thousand lines are
#                 the code lines of that repository's own pinned language, summed
#                 out of the report's per-file metrics and nothing else: the
#                 in the tree, which would divide a TypeScript rule's findings by
#                 the repository's JavaScript build scripts as well and report a
#                 rate lower than the truth. Only `reliability.*` and
#                 the secrets pack rather than replacing it, and those findings
#   measured_at   the value measured when the rule landed, as a date
#   ticket        what the number was measured for
# One file, two readers: tests/profile_corpus.rs enforces max_corpus, and
# scripts/profile_noise.py enforces max_per_kloc against the pinned noise set
# in research/embedded-profiles/noise-set.md. There is one source of truth for
# a rule's noise budget and it is this file.
# Each limit is the value measured when the rule landed, with a stated ticket,
# never a hoped-for number. The 2.2 noise policy, from map #103, is removal
# rather than tuning: a `warning` rule holds at or below 0.25 findings per kLOC
# and an `info` rule at or below 1.0, on any one repository of the pinned noise
# set. A rule over its ceiling is not widened, re-tuned in place, or given a
# bigger limit. One `paths` exclusion per rule is allowed before removal, and
# it is recorded in the header comment of the document that carries the rule.
# If the rule is still over the ceiling, or the breach is not confined to a
# path class, the rule is removed: its row here goes, its positive manifest
# rows go because the recall floor would otherwise fail on a rule that no
# longer ships, its negative rows and their justifications stay in place, and
# the document's @N is bumped because a rule id disappeared.
